description: Boot-smoke milestone baselines. Owner decision 22 (2026-09-18) replaced the self-tracking `190 + 2 x transport sectors` menu identity with two independent numbers: an absolute ceiling that states the owner's real budget, and a delta against the baseline below. The 2026-09-20 re-basing applies the same shape to the `loader` milestone, which until then was gated only by accident through a hard-coded frame-300 observation point in the boot smoke. Re-record `baseline` deliberately, in the same commit as the change that grows the transport on purpose, and state the reason in the commit message.

recorded.reason: Re-recorded for roadmap 4.3, which adds the resident direct-SIO sector reader as the ninth DFMC record: 730 B RAW landing at $A000, +6 transport sectors (183 -> 189). MEASURED from a full 8-session boot smoke of this build, 8/8 passed. The ATR milestones move +11 frames (loader 297 -> 308, menu 554 -> 565) - inside the +50 fail band, over the +10 warn band, and well under the plan's own +20-frame estimate. The XEX milestones do NOT move (loader 135, menu 392) even though the XEX grew 1,000 B for the reader block and the XEX-only level-1 image: the binary loader places those blocks before the game's own start milestone. The `-nobasic` sessions remain the baseline; `-basic` boots still run 9 (XEX) to 18 (ATR) frames earlier and only ever pass.
